overview_description.description:
Routable is a payout orchestration platform that enables companies to automate, manage, and scale payouts globally through a developer-first API, compliance infrastructure, and operational tools.

It was founded in 2017 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington.

about_short_description.short_description: Routable is a payout orchestration platform that enables companies to automate, manage, and scale payouts globally.

product.name: AP Automation Platform
product.description: A platform that automates accounts payable processes including invoice capture, approval workflows, payment reconciliation, and PO matching to streamline business payments.

product.name: Mass Payments
product.description: A service enabling businesses to send thousands of payments quickly and securely worldwide via CSV upload or API.

product.name: International Payments
product.description: A service for making cross-border payments in over 140 currencies to more than 220 countries and territories within 1-3 business days.

product.name: Vendor Management System
product.description: A system to onboard, pay, and monitor vendors and contractors while managing compliance and tax documentation.

product.name: Payments API
product.description: An API that enables businesses to send and receive payments programmatically, supporting real-time and scheduled payouts.
